column2: 382 DTI scans from 142 subjects: corpus callosum (cca, 93 points) and right corticospinal tract (rcst, 55 points).

Goldsmith et al. (2011), Penalized Functional Regression, JCGS 20, 830-851; Goldsmith et al., Longitudinal Penalized Functional Regression for Cognitive Outcomes on Neuronal Tract Measurements, JRSS C 61, 453-469.

Nodes: cca then rcst on separate point-index grids 1:93 and 1:55; no physical coordinates are supplied. Native scan labels ID_visit are the unique curve IDs. All original scalar covariates and row order are retained, including repeated numeric subject ID. Sex factor labels are retained (source levels: male, female). NA/NaN tract cells become unobserved mask entries, without interpolation. The MRI/DTI data were collected at Johns Hopkins University and the Kennedy-Krieger Institute.
